answers.reason: The senate decides on matters of the whole university and does not include deans as a specific group body.
Deans lead faculties and participate in budget allocations for their units.
Appointment committees select candidates for professorships, which are faculty matters overseen by deans.
A dean leads a faculty and takes part in its affairs handled by the faculty council.
Examination boards decide on individual student examination matters, not deans as a group body.
